sdd.spec_guidance: Keep requirements explicit and mark assumptions as open questions.
sdd.plan_guidance: Separate confirmed project facts from inferred implementation choices.
sdd.task_guidance: Ensure each task has validation evidence.
risk_prompts: Do not treat missing evidence as confirmation.

sdd.spec_guidance: Capture context, containers/components and architecturally significant requirements.
sdd.plan_guidance: Use lightweight C4-style context/container/component views when useful.
sdd.task_guidance: Include architecture validation tasks for boundary changes.
risk_prompts: Architecture docs must stay traceable to code map evidence.

sdd.spec_guidance: Capture channels, producers, consumers, message schemas and broker/protocol constraints.
sdd.plan_guidance: Separate send/receive operations and infrastructure assumptions.
sdd.task_guidance: Include message contract validation and integration tasks.
risk_prompts: Do not infer sender and receiver symmetry without evidence.

sdd.spec_guidance: Capture API consumers, resources, auth, request/response and error contracts.
sdd.plan_guidance: Keep API contract and implementation changes traceable.
sdd.task_guidance: Include contract validation and compatibility tasks.
risk_prompts: API docs can drift from implementation routes.

sdd.spec_guidance: Capture deployment, runtime config, startup/restart and observability requirements.
sdd.plan_guidance: Identify deployment artifacts, CI gates and runtime rollback paths.
sdd.task_guidance: Include smoke checks and operational verification.
risk_prompts: Runtime config and deploy scripts can diverge from local development behavior.

sdd.spec_guidance: Capture package/app boundaries, runtime version, dependency and config expectations.
sdd.plan_guidance: Identify pyproject/requirements, package layout, async boundaries, and test framework.
sdd.task_guidance: Include targeted pytest and lint tasks based on project conventions.
risk_prompts: Python projects can be app-only, package-only, or mixed; do not infer publishability from source files alone.

sdd.spec_guidance: Capture user workflows, states, accessibility and responsive behavior.
sdd.plan_guidance: Identify UI surfaces and required browser/desktop verification.
sdd.task_guidance: Include UI regression checks and Playwright only for web/MiniApp changes.
risk_prompts: UI changes need surface-specific verification, not only unit tests.

sdd.spec_guidance: Capture when a change requires an explicit decision record.
sdd.plan_guidance: Propose ADRs for significant technology, boundary, data or deployment decisions.
sdd.task_guidance: Include ADR update tasks when architecture changes.
risk_prompts: Do not invent historical decisions; record new decisions as proposed.

sdd.spec_guidance: Capture entities, migration constraints, consistency and rollback requirements.
sdd.plan_guidance: Identify schema changes, migration ordering and data compatibility risks.
sdd.task_guidance: Include migration and rollback validation.
risk_prompts: Data changes can be irreversible without explicit rollback planning.

sdd.spec_guidance: Capture project SDK, target frameworks, app type, packages and hosting model.
sdd.plan_guidance: Identify solution structure, SDK ids, project references, NuGet dependencies, and build/test commands.
sdd.task_guidance: Include dotnet restore/build/test validation tasks.
risk_prompts: SDK-style projects may use implicit imports and Directory.Build.props.

sdd.spec_guidance: Capture board, target chip, peripherals, timing, power, and update constraints.
sdd.plan_guidance: Model FreeRTOS tasks, components, partition layout, flashing, OTA and hardware assumptions.
sdd.task_guidance: Include build/flash/monitor validation and hardware-in-loop checks.
risk_prompts: Firmware validation may require connected hardware and target-specific configuration.

sdd.spec_guidance: Capture package type, runtime/browser target, workspace and script expectations.
sdd.plan_guidance: Identify package scripts, module type, workspaces and frontend/backend split.
sdd.task_guidance: Include npm/pnpm/yarn test/build validation tasks when scripts exist.
risk_prompts: package.json may be tooling-only; inspect scripts and source before assuming application type.

sdd.spec_guidance: Capture PlatformIO environments, boards, frameworks and upload/debug requirements.
sdd.plan_guidance: Build a board/environment matrix from platformio.ini.
sdd.task_guidance: Include PlatformIO build/test/upload validation tasks.
risk_prompts: Multiple PlatformIO environments can target different boards and frameworks.

rules.reason: Rust source found under a Cargo src directory.

sdd.spec_guidance: Capture crate boundaries, library vs binary target, and safety-sensitive requirements.
sdd.plan_guidance: Identify Cargo workspace layout, feature flags, async runtime, FFI/native links, and build script constraints.
sdd.task_guidance: Include cargo check/test/clippy validation tasks where applicable.
risk_prompts: Cargo features and target-specific cfg flags may change behavior.
